_comment: MuseScore archive songs (PDMX): solo piano scores outside classical, folk and religious music (pop, rock, soundtrack, jazz, and unlabelled scores by composers outside the classical list) that the uploader declared public domain or CC0 with no licence conflict. The user's broad copyright reading (2026-10-16): no check of the author's date, so a modern arrangement that the declaration does not cover is a risk the repository carries. Chosen by content/tools/pdmx_songs.py; two removal-only lenses (junk, content safety) took out the flagged ones. Not reviewed by eye. Every gate passed, and the frozen heuristic places each song. Capped at 1000 pieces at levels 1 to 4 by rating (level 5 is not capped; level 6 is pdmx-songs-advanced.json). Not shipped: 1585 failed a gate, 47 duplicates (dedupe.py), 22 out of scope, 1267 beyond the cap.
